name: quiet-editorial
title: Quiet Editorial
summary: Serif display with a grotesk body, generous whitespace and a single accent. For content-led products, portfolios, journals and calm landing pages.
imagery: Warm natural-light photography with real textures; no 3D renders, no stock smiles.
rules: Headlines in the display serif, left-aligned, weight 400-500; never a bold serif.
Body text 16 px with lineHeight 1.5, lines at most 640 px wide.
One accent colour, used for links, one primary action and small marks only.
Hairline rules (1 px, line colour) instead of cards and shadows.
Large outer margins (64-96 px on desktop); 96 px between sections.
At most two font weights per screen.
